name: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 5: Kazahanaki
original_name: 遙かなる時空の中で5 風花記
source:
The two worlds---
And the heroine who crossed between the two worlds to save those who are important to her.

However, a life has slipped through her hands...

"I will try to save everyone this time."
With that determination, she sets upon another journey and writes the history anew.

[written by Nyororo on [url=http://forum.my-neoromance.com/index.php?/topic/2676-harukanaru-toki-no-nakade-5-kazahanaki/]MyNeoRomance forums[/url]]
translation:
两个世界——以及往返于两界之间、为了拯救重要之人的女主角。

然而，她却眼睁睁看着一条生命从手中溜走……

“这一次，我要试着拯救所有人。”
怀抱着这份决心，她再次踏上旅途，重新书写历史。
